ingest.note: Pipecat pipelines move 16 kHz PCM mono frames through services by default. Audio is normalized at the transport ingress.

egress.note: TTS/realtime outputs are resampled to the pipeline rate before reaching the transport.

potholes.note: Pipecat transports (e.g. FastAPI websocket, Exotel, Twilio) decode μ-law to PCM at the edge. Verify the chosen transport handles your telephony codec; raw websocket transports may need a custom decoder.
Turn endpointing uses a VAD/endpointing service separate from STT. Mis-tuning it causes false barge-in or long pauses.

interruption.description: Pipecat 1.0+ uses user_turn_strategies in LLMUserAggregatorParams. When the VAD detects user speech, an InterruptionFrame propagates through the pipeline, discarding pending output frames. The transport serializer handles provider-specific clearing.
interruption.code_hint: LLMUserAggregatorParams(vad_analyzer=SileroVADAnalyzer()) — interruption is automatic. TwilioFrameSerializer sends clear automatically.
